packageRules.description: Merge minor and patch updates of packages at 1.0 or later once the ci check passes. Major updates, and updates of packages at 0.x, where a minor update may break things, wait for a person.
Merge updates of the GitHub Actions, which are pinned by digest, once the ci check passes.
Keep the Node.js types at the oldest Node.js release line the bot supports (engines in package.json), so that the type check catches what that release lacks.
Hold TypeScript below 7: it drops moduleResolution node10, which tsconfig.json uses, and ts-jest and ts-node have to support it first. Revisit then.
